To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) The deamino-carba analogs of vasotocin were synthesized by solid phase methodology with linkage agent and with Fmoc technique.
(1) The analogs of deaminocarba-1 and deaminocarbo-6 oxytocins with phenylalanin in position 2 (Phe2) and ornithine in postion 8 (Orn8) were synthesized by solid phase methodology.

the deamino-carba analogs of oxytocin have preserved high uterotropic in vivo activity in spite of their partial agonistic character, that their pressor and antinatriuretic properties are moderate, and that the protection of the δ-amino group by benzyloxymethyl group decreases the pressor and antiduretic activities, whereas the uterotonic activity remains high.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of new analogs of deaminocarba-oxytocin with ornithine at position 8.
the synthesis and biological activity of two deamino-carba analogs of oxytocin, [Phe2Orn8] deamino-carbaoxytocin (1) and [PHe2Orn8J deamino-carb6oxytocin (II), and their corresponding sulfoxides.
the synthesis of new deamino-carba analogs of oxytocin and with the evaluation of their biological properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the deamino carbo analogs with protected δ-amino group in position 8 have retained high uterotonic potency, but lost their pressor and antitidiuretic agonist activities.
the deamino-carba modification of the oxytocin molecule is not a suitable model for the study of structure-activity relationships of the oxytocic and pressor activities of this peptide.
the carba-1 analog has a higher uterotonic activity than the carba-6 analog.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the deamino-carba analogs of vasotocin have preserved high uterine activity and moderate antidiuretic and pressor activities, and that the deaminoxycarbonyl analogs are more potent than the deaminocarbonyl ones.
the carba analogs of vasotocin are more active than vasopressin in all biological tests.
the deamino carbas in position 1 and 6 are tolerated in oxytocin molecule and they can be used as starting point for the synthesis of analogs with improved pharmacological properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the carba analogs of oxytocin are very sensitive to the nature of ornithine residue in position 8.
the analogs with δ-aminopropyl group in position 8 have high biological activity, and the position of the carba bridge is not so important.

the analogs with protected δ-amino group are very stable to the degradation by carboxypeptidase B and to the enzymatic hydrolysis by chymotrypsin and trypsin, but are less active in uterotonic and pressor assays than the deprotected analogs.
